name: dumbbell good morning squat
description: Blend a good morning hinge with a squat while holding a dumbbell. Builds the posterior chain and legs.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Stand back up and then sit down into a squat.
Repeat the hinge and squat as one rep.
